suggestions.guidance_rule: Users outside the IBM organization are strictly prohibited from viewing IBM employee data.
suggestions.missing_context: The target employee's organization is not in tool arguments — get_employee/get_passport/etc. only take user_id. The policy cannot know the target's org without a DB lookup.
suggestions.reason: Enforcing cross-org data isolation requires knowing both the acting user's org (available in subject) and the target employee's org (requires DB lookup, not in tool args).

suggestions.guidance_rule: A Manager may view only their direct reports' data, in addition to their own.
suggestions.missing_context: Whether args.user_id is a direct report of the acting user requires a DB lookup of the target's manager_id field.
suggestions.reason: The policy can check subject.user_id == args.user_id for self-access, but cannot determine direct-report relationships without a DB lookup at policy evaluation time.

suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee's salary may be updated only by HR or by that employee's direct manager.
suggestions.missing_context: Whether the acting user is the direct manager of the target employee requires a DB lookup of the target's manager_id.
suggestions.reason: Salary update by direct manager cannot be enforced without knowing which employees report to the acting user at policy evaluation time.

suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee who is on the blacklist (persona non grata list) may not update their passport information.
suggestions.missing_context: Whether the acting user is on the blacklist is not present in system_vars.json.
suggestions.reason: Blacklist status is not a standard system variable; it must be added as a subject claim to be enforceable at the policy layer.

suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee may update their home address only to an address within their own current country; changing the address to a different country is not allowed.
suggestions.missing_context: The employee's current country_code is not exposed in system_vars.json and cannot be derived from update_employee arguments alone.
suggestions.reason: Comparing the new home_address country to the employee's current country requires knowing the current country at policy evaluation time.

suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee's emergency contact must reside in the same area as the employee.
suggestions.missing_context: The employee's current location/area is not exposed in system_vars.json.
suggestions.reason: Enforcing area co-location between employee and emergency contact requires the employee's current city/area as a subject claim.

suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee may not create a time-off request unless they have sufficient available balance for the requested leave type.
suggestions.missing_context: Leave balance is a computed DB value, not available in tool arguments or system variables.
suggestions.type: object mapping leave_type to remaining days
suggestions.reason: Balance enforcement requires either a DB lookup or pre-populating available balances per leave type as a subject claim.

suggestions.guidance_rule: A Paternity leave request may be approved only if the requester has provided both the baby's birth date and the baby's name in their chat messages to the agent.
suggestions.missing_context: Conversation history content is not available in tool arguments or system variables.
suggestions.reason: Enforcing this rule requires either the agent to set a derived flag in the extensions before the tool call, or access to the full conversation history.

suggestions.guidance_rule: A time-off request's status may be changed by the requester's direct manager (to Approved or Denied only).
suggestions.missing_context: update_time_off_status only takes request_id and status — the policy cannot determine who owns the request or who their manager is without a DB lookup.
suggestions.reason: Allowing manager-specific Approved/Denied transitions requires knowing the request's owner and whether the acting user is their manager.

suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee's leave allotments, time-off requests, and leave balance may be viewed only by HR, the employee themselves, or the employee's direct manager.
suggestions.missing_context: get_leave_allotments, list_time_off_requests, and get_leave_balance use user_id in args; self-access (args.user_id == subject.user_id) is enforceable, but manager-of-target access requires a DB lookup.
suggestions.reason: HR and self checks are enforceable; manager access to subordinate leave data requires knowing direct reports at policy evaluation time.

note: These are suggestions for future system variable additions. They are NOT part of the current policy.
